title: Alhambra Tour with Katia was a high point of our trip to Spain
text: My wife and I did a private tour with Katia and it was one of the best tours we have been on ( we do lots of tour). It was a history lesson as well as a tour. Katia is a very knowledgeable person. She is engaging, professional and asked if we had questions throughout the tour and gave thoughtful responses. Our tour with Katia was a high point of the four cities we visited in Spain and I strongly recommend taking her tour.
author: JamesG_C

title: Family trip
text: Great experience with Katya. She showed us Alhambra in and told us a lot about history. She is very knowledgeable. We had a big group and she was very accommodating. It was a pleasure to visit Alhambra and learn all of the stories and see this great site with such a great guide!
author: Yelenash74

title: Go with Katya to the Alhambra
text:
Katya was great and exceeded our expectations. She did a great job of setting the context of the place and then showing us the specifics. She shared photos on her phone to make connects to other places and art work. She was approachable, patient and added some fun stories along with tons of great info. She was responsive to our interests and took time to answer our questions.

We were so happy we hired her for the four of us as we had a fabulous tour!
author: VikkiSteve

title: Buying tickets to the Alhambra is not enough. Get a guide.
text: This is a great way to see the Alhambra with a private, knowledgeable guide. I would not have the total appreciation of the monument without her explanation.Katya, has encyclopedic knowledge of the landmark and his expert at navigating through the crowds. I love the history and explanation, and my wife likes a brief right to the point evaluation. Katya was able to navigate both of our personalities.
author: Jay_E

title: Excellent private tour of Alhambra with good communication and planning...
text:
We had a wonderful tour with Katya.  She was knowledgeable about the General Life and the Alhambra took time to provide historical context as well as details about what we saw on our tour.  The tour was paced well and we had plenty of time for questions and photos.  

Katya was very responsive for communication.  She worked with us to schedule our tour so that it fit in to our time constraints in Granada.  Additionally, she was very helpful in advice on getting the appropriate tickets for the Alhambra as they were in short supply for our time in Granada.

I would wholeheartedly recommend sched
author: David_R

title: Excellent experience.
text: On this trip in Andalusia I can now rate the guides taking Katya as a reference: very knowledgeable and above all interested in sharing that knowledge. The tour was done at a leisurely pace that allowed us to know without haste the relevant details. Definitely the best guided experience in a long time.  (And we really enjoyed Boris' extra company!). Congratulations, Katya.
